newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal-W new issue priced at PLN 12.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal-W new issue priced at PLN 12.

text.p: The Polish construction company Mostostal Warszawa priced its new 1.5 million share issue at 12 zlotys following a book-building process, the company's chief executive said on Friday.
"After the book building the issue price was set at 12 zlotys per share," Karol Heidrich told a news conference.
He also said that the issue to be offered ex-rights on subscription from September 23, has been underwritten in full by four institutions.

Heidrich said Creditanstalt Securities SA agreed to take up 500,000 shares, Creditanstalt Investmentbank AG 250,000 shares, Polish brokerage DM Penetrator underwrote 600,000 shares and Bank Handlowy SA securities unit 150,000 shares. A stand-by fee would be 2.3 percent of the value of the underwritten shares.
The large investor 1.2 million-share tranche will be offered on September 23 and 24 and the 300,000-share retail subscription is scheduled for September 25-27.

The company which earlier said it would offer the shares at no less than 10 zlotys said it would use the funds from the capital increas to buy new machinery and launch a new production line to boost production capacity.

Heidrich also said the company wanted to focus in the future on four areas where it expected the highest investment growth: environment, transport infrastructure, modernisation of chemical and refining industries and municipal developments such as shopping centres and parking facilities.
He also said the company wanted to maintain a 30-percent share of exports in its overall sales and saw former Soviet republics, especially Ukraine as main business growth areas.
